name: maison-doree
description: Maison Dorée bakery: website (client), admin panel (admin) and API (server). These scripts are what hosting providers like Render run.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix admin --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run build
